result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a missing icon inside the top-right circular header button.

issues.description: The circular action button in the top-right corner next to the delivery address displays a grey background and a red notification badge dot, but the icon itself (e.g., notification bell or cart icon) is missing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the icon asset or SVG renders properly inside the circular header button with visible contrast against the light grey background.
